assumptions: Host terrain-only checks use no NPC occupancy. Actors, trainer sight lines, moving NPCs and story removals require runtime observations; passing paths are conditional, never acceptance.
Coordinates in route manifest are unpadded source cells. Report coordinates are runtime padded cells; fixed Hideout packet is already runtime coordinates (all Hideout padding is zero).
No Cut, gate, boulder, Snorlax or ghost mutation is applied. Closed geometry is checked as pinned; required post-event changes are explicit gaps, never debug-state shortcuts.
Spinner forced paths come from pinned rocketHideoutStory/scenes.json; every forced cell is collision checked. Ordinary path searches do not simulate spinner triggers.
Hideout elevator floor choice is runtime dependent. Cabin entries reuse existing project_warp; exit selection/guard doors are not certified without the actual earned menu/flags.
B1F lift door stays closed; return uses fixed B2F route and entrance stairs.
5.5b data is inactive preparation only. Its gaps never become current 5.5a blockers.
Safari admission, step/ball budgets, encounters and Escape Rope checkpoint are runtime dependencies. Surf, Strength and Cycling require earned capabilities; terrain checks do not establish them.
All unresolved movement and interaction call sites are enumerated exactly with method/line. Duplicate manual checks do not imply call-site certification.

Tower 6F source (10,17) and Fuchsia source (28,20) are literal driver walking waypoints, not mutable obstacle targets. Their blocked land collision is a prepared 5.5b defect, not excused by future story flags.
